```sql
SELECT l.name, COUNT(c.copy_id) AS total_copies
FROM library l
JOIN copy c ON l.library_id = c.library_id
JOIN book b ON c.book_id = b.book_id
WHERE b.genre = 'fantasy'
AND l.city = 'Lyon'
GROUP BY l.library_id
ORDER BY total_copies DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

FROM copy
JOIN book ON copy.book_id = book.book_id
JOIN library ON copy.library_id = library.library_id
WHERE book.genre = 'fantasy' AND library.city = 'Lyon'
GROUP BY library.library_id, library.name
ORDER BY num_copies DESC
LIMIT 1;
